preconditions.description: There are exactly 5 rows of input.
Each registration code is at most 11 characters long.

preconditions.expression: all(code.isalnum() or '-' in code for code in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each registration code consists of uppercase letters, digits, or dashes.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'HE GOT AWAY!' or all(int(x) in range(1, 6) for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output is either 'HE GOT AWAY!' or a space-separated list of integers between 1 and 5.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'HE GOT AWAY!' or all('FBI' in stdin.splitlines()[int(x) - 1] for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output list corresponds to a row with a registration code containing 'FBI'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'HE GOT AWAY!' or len(set(stdout.split())) == len(stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output list contains no duplicate integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'HE GOT AWAY!' or stdout == ' '.join(map(str, sorted([i + 1 for i, code in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()) if 'FBI' in code])))
postconditions.description: The output list is sorted in increasing order.
